title: Senior Base24 Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Duration: Long-term

Employment Type: Full-Time


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

title: Senior Cloud Solution Architect
description:
Senior Cloud Solution Architect- Automation

Brazil/Argentina (Remote)

Long-term contract


In this role, you will:

  • Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.
  • End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.
  • API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).
  • ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.
  • Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.


Technical Expertise:

  • Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.
  • Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.
  • .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.
  • Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.
  • Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.
  • Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.
  • Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.


Specialized Skills:

  • Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.
  • Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.
  • Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.
  • Soft Skills and Others:
  • Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.
  • Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

  • Ajustar pipelines ETL/ELT no Dataflow e Cloud Composer, promovendo eficiência e escalabilidade.

  • Forte domínio em SQL e otimização de consultas.
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados e integração entre múltiplas fontes (estruturadas e não estruturadas).

  • Experiência prévia com DevOps/SRE focado em DataOps.

E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Consultor(a) SAP FICO
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Procuramos profissionais que também queiram impactar o mundo positivamente! Você é um deles? Se sim, cadastre-se na vaga abaixo!

  • Papel principal na coordenação de equipes de mapeamento, implantação e operação de soluções corporativas.
  • Planejar, coordenar e monitorar projetos SAP, garantindo a entrega conforme cronograma e orçamento.
  • Gerenciar demandas corretivas, evolutivas e melhorias contínuas em sistemas SAP.

  • Planejar e acompanhar a alocação de recursos SAP junto a liderança de delivery conforme necessidade e prioridade dos projetos


Requisitos:

  • Superior Completo em Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação ou Engenharia da Computação;
  • Certificação oficial PMP (Project Management Professional) ou PgMP (Program Management Professional);
  • Experiência como Gerente de Projetos SAP em empresa de Saneamento Básico e/ou Utilities;
  • Conhecimento de Gerenciamento de Projetos;
  • Ter atuado com demandas AMS SAP;
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conhecimento avançado em ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Jira, Trello, MS Project, Asana, Monday.com).
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Pensamento analítico e foco em resultados. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação com múltiplas áreas. Perfil colaborativo, com facilidade para trabalhar em equipes multidisciplinares. Proatividade, autonomia e senso de urgência. Visão centrada no cliente, com capacidade de equilibrar expectativas e metas de negócio.


Regime de Contratação: CLT

Atuação: Remota com Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais ao cliente.


Junte-se ao nosso time inspirador, confiável e solidário. Somos apaixonados pelo nosso trabalho, valorizamos a integridade e a responsabilidade pessoal em todos os níveis desde o primeiro dia, tratamos todos com dignidade e respeito, e estendemos nossa responsabilidade à nossa comunidade, à sociedade e ao meio ambiente.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.

Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team!


Dingus & Zazzy is a comprehensive digital marketing agency offering services for brands looking to expand their presence across a variety of digital platforms. Running a company is a little like building a plane while flying it. There’s always too much to do; doing one thing means neglecting something else. You have to blog but also be active on social media. You have to build websites and then optimize them for mobile. Email lists. Emails. Keywords. SEM. SEO. UX. UI. FML. OMG. That’s where we come in. We provide an unlimited get-shit-done subscription for our clients. And we need your help!


About You


  • Highly motivated and passionate about delivering excellent work
  • Proactive, always anticipating potential challenges and crafting solutions
  • Strong communicator, ensuring clarity with both internal teams and clients
  • Professional level of English (written and spoken)
  • Friendly, respectful, and able to work effectively within a team
  • Detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful—you find answers when needed and make sure things are running smoothly
  • You’re a people person and love finding ways to solve problems with creative ideas
  • Excellent time management and ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously
  • You love talking through ideas, offering feedback, and helping teams align with client goals
  • A background in marketing is essential
  • Nerdiness is a bonus! If you love D&D, Pokémon, video games, or books, we’ll get along just fine!


Purpose of the Role


The Marketing Coordinator role combines project coordination with client relationship management, acting as a bridge between internal teams and clients. This role supports smooth project execution by managing internal communication, task coordination, and ensuring that all client deliverables are met on time, within budget, and to the highest standard. You'll be integral in managing both the marketing efforts and client interactions, translating client goals into actionable tasks, and ensuring the process runs seamlessly from start to finish.


Main Objectives


1-Client Collaboration & Project Oversight:

  • Collaborate with clients to understand their marketing goals and expectations.
  • Translate these goals into clear tasks for the Marketing Coordinator, ensuring smooth project execution.
  • Regularly meet with clients to review deliverables, adjust timelines, and maintain strong relationships.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring satisfaction.


2-Internal Team Coordination:

  • Work closely with designers, copywriters, media buyers, and other team members to develop high-quality marketing materials across all service offerings.
  • Organize internal kick-off meetings, assign tasks, and ensure that everything stays on schedule and within scope.
  • Provide clear direction and thoughtful feedback to internal teams to ensure work meets or exceeds client expectations.
  • Ensure all project management tools (Asana, Trello, ClickUp) and Teamwork boards are up to date.


3-Communication & Task Management:

  • Manage meetings with clients, ensuring clear action plans and next steps.
  • Review and approve final deliverables before submission, making sure they meet client goals and expectations.
  • Use tools like Jiminny to document meetings, share important notes, and ensure all action items are tracked.
  • Keep all teams aligned through regular check-ins and updates, making sure deadlines are met and no tasks fall through the cracks.


4-Resource Planning & Problem Solving:

  • Manage multiple projects at once, ensuring each one is progressing smoothly, with no delays or miscommunication.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, whether they relate to resources, deadlines, or client feedback.
  • Proactively anticipate problems and find creative solutions to keep projects on track.


5-Strategic & Process-Oriented Thinking:

  • Help shape the big-picture marketing strategy with the Senior Account Manager.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve internal workflows, ensuring efficiency and consistent delivery.
  • Build strong, positive relationships both within the team and with clients, helping to drive long-term success.


Additional Skills

  • Project Management: Skilled at managing timelines and juggling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Verbal & Written Communication: Excellent communication skills—both internally and with clients.
  • Emotional Intelligence: Able to handle complex client personalities and stay calm under pressure.
  • Time Management: Proficient in balancing meetings, internal work, and client deliverables without missing a beat.
  • Presentation Skills: Comfortable leading client meetings and representing the agency confidently.


Our operating hours are from 9 am to 5 pm MST, Monday to Friday.

Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now—let’s get talking, get making, and go get that bacon.

title: Senior Benefits Manager LATAM
description:
The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent.

You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—including health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.


Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee-centered benefits programs.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) DevOps Sênior para atuar na gestão, automação e proteção de ambientes complexos na AWS , em um projeto estratégico de uma empresa americana .

Você será peça-chave na implementação de práticas de DevSecOps , garantindo que nossas arquiteturas sejam escaláveis, seguras, robustas e em conformidade com padrões internacionais. Se você domina AWS e a filosofia IaC (Infrastructure as Code) , essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Segurança e Governança AWS : Implementar e gerenciar melhores práticas de segurança em ambientes multi-conta, utilizando serviços como AWS Organizations, IAM, Security Hub e Control Tower.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) : Desenvolver e manter toda a infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e/ou CloudFormation, garantindo padronização, automação e rastreabilidade.
  • CI/CD Seguro : Projetar, implementar e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD para garantir entregas rápidas e seguras em nuvem.
  • Monitoramento e Resposta : Implementar e gerenciar soluções de monitoramento e logging (CloudWatch, ELK, Prometheus/Grafana) para identificação e resolução proativa de incidentes.
  • Conformidade e Auditoria : Assegurar que infraestrutura e aplicações estejam em conformidade com políticas de segurança e requisitos regulatórios, apoiando auditorias.
  • Colaboração e DevSecOps : Trabalhar em parceria com equipes de desenvolvimento para integrar práticas de segurança desde o início do ciclo de vida (shift-left).
  • Inovação : Pesquisar e propor soluções inovadoras para aprimorar continuamente a postura de segurança da empresa.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) DevOps, com foco em segurança e gestão de ambientes AWS.
  • Profundo conhecimento de serviços AWS: IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, RDS, RedShift, Lambda, Security Hub, Control Tower e AWS Organizations.
  • Experiência prática com IaC (Terraform e/ou CloudFormation).
  • Experiência na implementação de pipelines de CI/CD (Github).
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de script (Python, Bash ) e ferramentas de monitoramento/logging.
  • Compreensão sólida de conceitos de segurança em nuvem, redes e sistemas operacionais.
  • Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com DevSecOps .
  • Certificações AWS relevantes (AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, AWS Certified Security – Specialty).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de contêineres (Docker).
  • Vivência em ambientes multi-conta ou em consultorias focadas em serviços AWS.



Se você busca um desafio internacional, com foco em segurança, automação e inovação em nuvem AWS , essa vaga é para você!

title: Business Systems Analyst
description:
Onebridge, a Marlabs Company, is a global AI and Data Analytics Consulting Firm that empowers organizations worldwide to drive better outcomes through data and technology. Since 2005, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government entities across the globe. We have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Business Systems Analyst to join our innovative and dynamic team.


Employment Type: Contract

Location: Remote - Brazil

Industry: IT & Services, Data & Analytics.


Business Systems Analyst | About You

As a Business Systems Analyst, you are responsible for supporting the success of a Pay-Per-Use program by identifying, triaging, and resolving data and process discrepancies tied to financial operations. You bring a strong analytical mindset, an understanding of how data flows across systems, and the ability to work cross-functionally across technical and business teams. You’re comfortable navigating reporting systems, investigating issues, and ensuring data accuracy that supports key financial processes such as billing and revenue recognition. While you don’t interact directly with external clients, your work plays a critical role in maintaining operational efficiency and enabling clean financial outcomes. You are detail-oriented, naturally curious, and confident working independently to drive resolution in a fast-paced environment.


Business Systems Analyst | Day-to-Day

  • Triage and resolve data issues within the Pay-Per-Use program by identifying root causes and directing them to the appropriate teams.
  • Maintain and manage the team’s Jira board, including issue tracking, documentation, and validation of outcomes.
  • Troubleshoot and update Tableau reports (10–15 dashboards), ensuring accuracy and relevance of the displayed data.
  • Write and modify SQL queries to investigate issues, validate fixes, and extract data as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with internal finance, technical, and business stakeholders to support billing and revenue-related processes.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.

title: Software Engineer, Data Integrations
description:
Blawk is building next-generation infrastructure to automate and analyze financial data at scale across the entertainment and creator economy.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer (Data Integrations) to help design and develop reliable automation pipelines for ingesting, mapping, and enriching large datasets from multiple external platforms. You’ll collaborate closely with our Founding Engineer to bring new data integrations online, enhance our normalization logic, and improve the reliability of ingestion across multiple environments.

This will start part-time, and advance to Full-time depending on performance.

  • Document integration workflows to support scalability and future maintenance.

  • Strong coding skills in JavaScript/TypeScript, mainly inside NestJS and Node.js
  • Strong Experience integrating front end with backend applications such as Next.js 
  • Experience with web automation frameworks (Playwright, Puppeteer, or similar).

  • Working proficiency in English (does not need to be fluent but able to communicate clearly with the team).

  • Algorithm & Data Structures fundamentals, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked list, DFS, BFS.
  • Experience in hands-on software development with thoughtfulness of scale, latency and distributed architecture.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Supabase, PostgreSQL, or other modern cloud databases .
  • Background in ETL pipelines, data normalization, or automation frameworks .
  • Familiarity with browser automation, headless environments, or task scheduling tools & Queue managers. 
  • Passion for building reliable data systems that simplify complex workflows.


Bonus If

  • experience working in media, entertainment, or fintech data systems.
  • Experience with international stakeholders

title: Talent Development Partner
description:

Turing accelerates frontier research with high-quality data, specialized talent, and training pipelines that advance thinking, reasoning, coding, multimodality, and STEM. For enterprises, Turing builds proprietary intelligence systems that integrate AI into mission-critical workflows, unlock transformative outcomes, and drive lasting competitive advantage.

Recognized by Forbes, The Information, and Fast Company among the world’s top innovators, Turing’s leadership team includes AI technologists from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, McKinsey, Bain, Stanford, Caltech, and MIT. Learn more at


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly creative and hands-on Senior Talent Development Partner to support the establishment of our newly formed Talent Development function. In this role, you will embrace a customer-centric, pragmatic approach, laser-focused on delivering maximum impact through the simplest, highest-quality solutions.

We are here for the growth and development of our customers, Turing Team Members. You will partner closely with leaders to understand their desired development outcomes, time constraints, and needs. Leveraging this knowledge, you will craft relevant, engaging learning content that drives measurable business results for our internal customers. You will seek out simple yet impactful solutions, recognizing that the most compelling learning experiences are often the most practical.


Responsibilities

  • Deeply collaborate with Turing leaders to translate team development needs into compelling, practical learning experiences driving measurable growth.
  • Design and develop engaging, multimedia-rich asynchronous learning content using tools like Articulate, tailoring for diverse styles through simple, high-impact solutions.
  • Serve as the go-to operational owner for the LMS system, curating and maintaining a dynamic, streamlined training catalog. Continuously refine materials for relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with customer needs.
  • Embody an agile, customer-obsessed mindset, rapidly producing high-quality, iterative content elevated by feedback and data.
  • Be a key driving force behind the development, engagement, and iterations of Sales and Engineering bootcamp programs.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience driving the development of L&D initiatives in a high-growth startup or late-stage tech environment.
  • Experienced leveraging LMS systems like Docebo, e-learning platforms, intranet solutions, and instructional design tools like Articulate to deliver impactful learning experiences.
  • Exceptional collaboration and interpersonal skills, with a strong customer-centric approach to building relationships and delivering outstanding service to stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to analyse training metrics, evaluate impact, and translate findings into actionable recommendations to enhance learning solutions.
  • Demonstrated skill in translating business objectives into innovative, engaging, and practical learning solutions that drive measurable results.


Values

  • We are client first : We put our clients at the centre of everything we do, because their success is the ultimate measure of our value.
  • We work at Start-Up Speed : We move fast, stay agile and favour action because momentum is the foundation of perfection
  • We are Al forward : We help our clients build the future of Al and implement it in our own roles and workflow to amplify productivity.


Advantages of joining Turing

  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

  • Set up proper tracking so we stop flying blind

Month 4-6: Build the Future

  • Launch point-to-point ticket sales (our 2-3x revenue opportunity)

Your Background

Must Have (Non-Negotiable):

  • Business-level Japanese - You've used it professionally, not just studied it
  • 3-5 years as a Product Manager in consumer e-commerce (D2C or B2C)
  • Hands-on GA4 experience - Custom events, conversion tracking, cohort analysis
  • Proven conversion optimization - You can tell us percentage improvements you've driven
  • E-commerce fundamentals - Product pages, checkout flows, cart abandonment strategies
  • Product-Market fit expertise - User research, market analysis, and translating customer behavior into product strategy


Nice to Have:

  • Experience in travel/tourism/hospitality
  • Technical background (can write basic SQL, understand APIs)
  • Living in a timezone within 5 hours of UK (but not required)
  • Experience working with Asian business partners


Don't Need:

  • CS degree or coding skills
  • Previous team management experience
  • Design skills (we have designers)


Why This Isn't Another Corporate PM Role

The Good:

  • Autonomy - You'll own the product roadmap, not execute someone else's vision
  • Impact - Your work affects millions of Japan travelers directly
  • Growth - We're profitable and expanding, not fighting for runway
  • Culture - 15 people globally, no corporate bureaucracy
  • Flexibility - Truly remote, work your hours, judge by output not activity


The Challenging:

  • You'll be the analytics expert - Our current PM doesn't use GA4, you'll need to lead here
  • Small team - No PM team to learn from, you'll need to be self-directed
  • Multiple platforms - JRPass.com (established) and JapanDen.com (startup mode)
  • Cultural bridge - Japanese partners expect relationship-building, UK team wants data and speed


The Reality:

  • You'll work with developers in Poland (4 people)
  • Report to Managing Director (day-to-day) and Head of Product (relationships)
  • Collaborate with growth marketer in Brazil
  • Travel to Japan 2x yearly (we pay, this is work not vacation)


Our Situation (Full Transparency)

Where We Are:

  • £30M+ annual revenue
  • Record organic traffic post-COVID
  • Conversion rate stuck at 2% (should be 3%+)
  • Limited analytics sophistication (we know this is a problem)


Where We're Going:

  • Launch point-to-point tickets (doubles addressable market)
  • Grow JapanDen.com into Japan's top travel authority site
  • Expand into hotels and activities
  • Potentially 2-3x revenue in 2-3 years


What We Need:

Someone who can figure out why our highest-ever traffic isn't converting, then fix it. Not theoretically - actually fix it with code changes, design tweaks, and A/B tests.


Compensation & Benefits

Salary: $50,000 - $70,000 USD annually (adjusted based on location)

  • We pay competitively for your market, not London rates
  • You'll likely earn more in purchasing power than UK-based equivalent


Benefits:

  • 20-25 days holiday + local public holidays
  • Pension/retirement contribution
  • Japan travel fully covered (2x yearly, 3-5 days each trip)
  • Flexible working hours (core overlap with UK business hours)
  • Home office stipend
  • Professional development budget


Why We're Being This Specific

Honestly? We've interviewed 30+ candidates. Many speak Japanese. Many are claiming Japanese skills. Others are business development or marketing people, not ecommerce product managers.


We need someone who actually fits this unusual profile: Japanese fluency + consumer e-commerce Product Mgr + analytics expertise + cultural bridge-building.


If that's you - genuinely you, not close-enough-you - we want to talk.


Our Team (15 People Globally)

  • London: 5 admin team members + Managing Director
  • Poland: 4 developers (your partners in building features)
  • Brazil: Growth marketer + social media
  • Current Head of Product: 15 years with company, manages supplier relationships
  • You: The analytics-driven, customer-obsessed PM we need


Three Final Thoughts:


1. On Japanese Language:

If you're thinking "my Japanese is probably good enough" - it's not. This role requires daily business use. If you can't negotiate contract terms or explain complex analytics concepts in Japanese, this won't work.


2. On E-commerce Experience:

B2B SaaS product management is different. Marketplace product management is different. We need someone who understands consumer purchase psychology, checkout optimization, and conversion funnels in retail contexts.


3. On Remote Work:

We're not "remote-friendly" - we're remote-first. But we need overlap with UK business hours (roughly 9am-6pm GMT). Think about whether your timezone works before applying.


Ready to Transform How Millions Experience Japan?

This is a rare role for a rare person.


If you have the unusual combination of skills we need, you'll have autonomy, impact, and growth opportunities most PMs don't get until much later in their careers.


JRPass.com is the world's leading Japan Rail Pass provider, helping millions of travellers explore Japan affordably and authentically. We're a profitable, growing company with 15 years of track record, expanding from rail passes into the comprehensive Japan travel platform.

We don't care where you're based, what degree you have, or whether you fit a traditional career path. We care that you can speak Japanese, optimize conversion funnels, and bridge two cultures. Everything else, we can teach.

Título do cargo: Analista de Performance & Insights


Localização: Brasil - 100% home office

Horário: De segunda-feira a sexta-feira das 09h00 às 18h00 ou das 10h00 às 19h00.



Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Objetivo do Cargo:


O Analista de Performance & Insights é o contador de histórias com dados da equipe de Marketing Direto, responsável por transformar resultados de campanhas e tendências de dados de primeira mão (1P) em insights acionáveis para o negócio . Esse profissional impulsiona a melhoria contínua ao medir o desempenho de CRM & Loyalty, identificar oportunidades de otimização e criar relatórios claros e prontos para tomada de decisão pelos stakeholders internos.

Com sólido conhecimento de modelos de dados de consumidores e relacionamentos entre entidades , essa pessoa conecta informações de diferentes fontes, canais e públicos para identificar os principais fatores de sucesso. É responsável por definir, monitorar e interpretar KPIs relacionados ao crescimento de dados 1P, engajamento do consumidor e efetividade das campanhas, garantindo que os esforços da equipe sejam mensuráveis, impactantes e alinhados às prioridades do negócio .

O cargo exige compreensão funcional de infraestrutura de dados de marketing e conceitos técnicos , permitindo colaboração eficiente com equipes de analytics, CDP e ativação — garantindo que os insights sejam confiáveis, contextualizados e incorporados às decisões estratégicas .


Principais Responsabilidades:


Dados, Mensuração & Otimização:

  • Definir, monitorar e evoluir KPIs-chave relacionados a campanhas de CRM & Loyalty, coleta de dados 1P, engajamento do consumidor e conversão.
  • Realizar análises detalhadas de performance de jornadas, e-mails, promoções e programas de dados 1P, traduzindo resultados em insights acionáveis.
  • Identificar tendências de performance e oportunidades de melhoria nos canais (e-mail, push, mídia paga) e fazer recomendações estratégicas para otimização das táticas de ativação.
  • Construir e manter scorecards de campanhas, benchmarks e frameworks de pós-campanha que padronizem a mensuração nos mercados.
  • Garantir que os insights sejam contextualizados, relevantes e facilmente compreendidos por stakeholders não técnicos (ex.: equipes de marca, conteúdo, CRM).


Suporte Estratégico:

  • Atuar como líder analítico da equipe de Marketing Direto, contribuindo para revisões de performance trimestrais e anuais, previsões e planejamento estratégico.
  • Colaborar com líderes de CRM & Ativação de Dados para incorporar aprendizados de dados em estratégias de segmentação, design de jornadas e lógica de público.
  • Monitorar campanhas em andamento para detectar sinais precoces de performance ou problemas, propondo ajustes em tempo real quando necessário.
  • Traduzir perguntas de negócio em hipóteses baseadas em dados , trabalhando com analytics ou equipes de dados para validar e explorar.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de melhores práticas de mensuração, modelagem de uplift e frameworks de experimentação .


Experiência & Competências Necessárias:


  • 5+ anos de experiência em análise de dados, relatórios de performance ou analytics de marketing , idealmente em CRM, Loyalty ou Engajamento do Consumidor.
  • Forte entendimento de estratégias de dados 1P , métricas de CRM (open rate, CTR, CVR, etc.) e acompanhamento de performance de campanhas de lifecycle.
  • Habilidade em interpretar dados de marketing e transformar conjuntos complexos de dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio .
  • Confortável trabalhando com modelos de dados relacionais e compreendendo relações entre entidades em plataformas como Salesforce CDP ou bancos de dados CRM.
  • Experiência com ferramentas analíticas (Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, etc.) para gerar visualizações e relatórios claros .
  • Capacidade comprovada de comunicar insights de forma clara e confiante a stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Perfil proativo, com forte visão de negócios e curiosidade para questionar suposições e identificar oportunidades.
  • Inglês avançado


Qualificações Desejáveis:


  • Experiência em CPG, varejo ou indústrias orientadas a loyalty , com alto volume de campanhas diretas ao consumidor.
  • Familiaridade com Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce CDP ou plataformas similares.
  • Experiência com testes A/B, frameworks de experimentação ou análise de lift incremental .
  • Compreensão de métricas do funil de marketing, tendências de engajamento e análise de cohort.
  • Experiência em segmentação de consumidores, modelagem de retenção ou análise de atribuição é um diferencial.



Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.

Nossos Valores

  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.

title: Senior Ruby Developer
description:
Location: Remote LATAM

Engagement: Part-time Contractor

Start Date: End of November

Duration: 2 sprints, with strong potential for continued work until June 2026

Schedule: ~25 hours per week


About the Role

We’re looking for a Ruby Specialist with deep experience in Discourse to deliver a fast, clean, and production-ready P1 integration between Discourse and an existing Community application. The integration includes SSO via Okta and OIDC, group and role mapping, backend adapters, shared UI elements, webhook delivery into our analytics stack, and a smooth cutover plan.

This is a high-impact engagement supporting an active squad. You’ll work closely with backend, frontend, security, IT, and data engineering partners to unblock engineers, validate designs, and land the integration safely behind feature flags. If the initial scope goes well, the engagement is expected to extend through mid-2026.

We’re looking for someone proactive, calm under pressure, and comfortable operating in a multi-team environment where clarity and speed matter.


Responsibilities
  • Deliver the P1 Discourse to a Community application integration within two sprints
  • Implement SSO using Okta and OIDC, ensuring secure token handling and session flows
  • Create and test group and role mapping between the Community roles and Discourse groups
  • Build backend Ruby adapters for moderation, taxonomy, and role syncing, gated behind feature flags
  • Implement shared header and navigation elements for a consistent cross-platform experience
  • Create and validate webhook pipelines from Discourse into Snowflake for analytics
  • Develop a clear cutover and rollback plan, including checklists and validation steps
  • Write or review technical designs, threat models, and operational readiness docs
  • Pair with frontend and backend engineers to land adapters, UI integration, and test coverage
  • Coordinate closely with Security and IT on Okta configuration, secrets, and access policies
  • Work with Data Engineering to finalize webhook schemas, retries, and observability
  • Support sprint ceremonies, demos, and unblock teammates on integration or Ruby-related work
  • Ensure all deliverables are tested, documented, and ready for production


Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails
  • Strong hands-on experience customizing and extending Discourse

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack criativo(a), proativo(a) e apaixonado(a) por inovação, para atuar em um projeto estratégico de uma empresa americana.

O desafio é desenvolver uma aplicação baseada em Agentic AI , composta por diversos agentes inteligentes que utilizam IA Generativa para analisar dados estruturados e gerar insights. Esses agentes trabalham de forma colaborativa para oferecer informações precisas e relevantes, apoiando decisões de negócio em tempo real. Você fará parte de um squad ágil , participando de todas as cerimônias do Scrum (dailies, planning, reviews e retros), colaborando com outros desenvolvedores em um ambiente dinâmico e de constante evolução tecnológica.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Desenvolver uma aplicação completa com foco em Agentic AI , desde a arquitetura até a entrega.
  • Criar e manter APIs seguras e escaláveis, seguindo boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Projetar interfaces de usuário dinâmicas e responsivas.
  • Implementar agentes inteligentes capazes de analisar dados estruturados e gerar relatórios financeiros automatizados.
  • Trabalhar em equipe dentro de um squad ágil, participando de todas as cerimônias do Scrum.
  • Colaborar na definição de soluções técnicas e na resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre tendências tecnológicas, especialmente em IA e cloud computing.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento Full Stack.
  • Domínio em Python e JavaScript , com prática em Node.js, React e Next.js .
  • Experiência comprovada na criação de APIs seguras e escaláveis.
  • Vivência com projetos de IA Generativa , incluindo uso de LLMs e bancos de dados vetoriais .
  • Experiência com SQL para manipulação e análise de dados estruturados.
  • Inglês fluente (leitura, escrita e conversação).
  • Perfil proativo, colaborativo e com sede de aprendizado.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento e experiência prática em AWS .
  • Habilidade na criação de soluções com arquitetura 100% AWS .
  • Familiaridade com serviços como AWS Bedrock .
  • Experiência na implementação de padrões RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) .
  • Certificações AWS são um plus.

title: Sr. Business Analyst & Product Design
description:
Role Overview:


The Business Analyst – Product Designer is a key member of the design team, partnering with business stakeholders and solution architects to deliver value-added features for sales, marketing, and billing teams. While the primary focus is on Service Sales CRM solutions, this role also provides exposure to a suite of enterprise applications. The BA transforms stakeholder visions into functional features, documents requirements, and works closely with development teams to bring solutions to life.


On a typical day you will:


  • Assess business processes, system landscapes, and user pain points to recommend technical solutions and workarounds.
  • Facilitate requirements gathering and functional design sessions with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Document detailed functional design specifications (epics, features, user stories).
  • Lead refinement sessions with Scrum teams to review feature designs, estimate effort, and prepare for sprint cycles.
  • Support QA and UAT test planning, execution, and bug triage.
  • Present live product demonstrations and prepare release notes for end users.
  • Assist with sprint planning, stakeholder communications, and retrospectives to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to change management through documentation, training, and stakeholder engagement.


What You Will Need to be Successful:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in business analysis, product design, or related roles, ideally within CRM platforms.
  • Strong background in requirements gathering, process mapping, and translating business needs into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile delivery methods, including writing user stories and partnering with Scrum teams.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional and global stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales strongly preferred) and exposure to cloud-based solutions, APIs, and system integrations.


Local Benefits or Selling Statement


This role offers the opportunity to work in a global environment, gaining exposure to local and international stakeholders. You will grow both business and technical skillsets while shaping CRM and enterprise applications that drive real impact across unique business streams.


Apply today to join us and build what’s next!.

title: Paid Media Campaign Manager (Brazil)
description:
Paid Media Campaign Manager (Remote)

Location: Remote

Schedule: 40 hours per week, PST hours (flexible contract)

Employment Type: Contract

Compensation: Competitive hourly rate in USD, based on experience



About Adquadrant


Adquadrant is the AI-powered growth partner for modern consumer brands.


We help high-growth companies scale intelligently by transforming data, creative, and media into a connected intelligence system that learns and optimizes every day. Our approach unites four core pillars: Brand Intelligence, Media, Creative, and Measurement, all orchestrated through an AI framework that continuously adapts to performance signals and market shifts. At the center is Prism, Adquadrant’s AI intelligence engine that unifies data from every channel, identifies growth patterns, and powers real-time decision-making with precision and clarity. Through this connected model, we have helped next-generation brands generate over a billion dollars in attributable revenue and build lasting momentum in a constantly evolving market. The next era of growth is intelligent. Adquadrant builds the system behind it.


About the Role


We are seeking a Paid Media Campaign Manager who is comfortable managing cross-channel (Google, YouTube, Meta, TikTok, etc) paid media campaigns for US-based e-commerce and lead generation brands and is fanatical about AI usage to empower better and faster outcomes for clients.. You will handle day-to-day media execution across platforms, dive deep into performance data, and bring a test-and-learn mindset to every campaign.

This role is ideal for someone who is both a strategist and an operator, who thrives on solving complex performance challenges, enjoys building from 0 to 1, and knows how to connect data insights to creative opportunities.


Key Responsibilities


Campaign Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Pmax, Shopping, Display, YouTube), Meta/Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and Microsoft Ads.
  • Manage and scale client budgets across multiple accounts, driving consistent ROAS and KPI achievement.
  • Analyze campaign data daily and adjust targeting, bidding, and creative to maximize performance.
  • Prepare performance reports using GA4, Looker Studio, Rockerbox, Supermetrics, and other attribution platforms.


Strategy & Innovation

  • Build and test strategies across new and emerging channels (e.g., Demand Gen, CTV, Retail Media).
  • Collaborate with creative and analytics teams to develop performance-driven media briefs.
  • Forecast and model potential performance outcomes using MMM, MTA, and cross-channel attribution data.


Client Collaboration

  • Partner closely with US-based teams and clients to align on objectives, budgets, and performance goals.
  • Present insights, strategic recommendations, and clear next steps in a client-facing capacity.
  • Proactively identify growth opportunities and communicate performance learnings.


Qualifications


  • 5+ years managing multi-channel paid media campaigns across both Paid Search and Paid Social.
  • Proven success optimizing toward ROAS, CPA, CPL, and revenue targets.
  • Experience managing large-scale budgets ($100K+/month) across multiple brands in the english speaking markets (US strongly preferred).
  • Proficiency with GA4, Rockerbox, Supermetrics, Looker Studio, or equivalent tools.
  • Understanding of forecasting, cross-channel attribution (MMM or MTA), and incrementality testing.
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort translating data into actionable strategy.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; able to communicate clearly and professionally with US-based clients.
  • Detail-oriented, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple accounts independently.
  • Hands-on experience writing creative briefs and collaborating with creative teams.
  • Google Ads and Meta certifications preferred; TikTok, Pinterest, or LinkedIn certifications are a plus.


Ideal Candidate Profile


  • Managed $500K+ in monthly ad spend across a diverse portfolio of eCommerce clients.
  • Experience launching new channels or products from 0–1 with measurable success.
  • Skilled in reporting, visualization, and data storytelling through GA4 and Supermetrics.
  • Excels in environments that value data-driven decisions, intellectual curiosity, and collaboration.
  • Naturally curious, proactive, and eager to continuously test and learn.
  • Passionate about media innovation, AI-driven performance insights, and delivering measurable impact.

title: Corretor de imóveis comerciais
description:
BROKER

Estamos em busca de Broker para nosso time!


A Binswanger está em busca de Broker com foco em Escritórios Corporativos para integrar nosso time de especialistas no mercado imobiliário corporativo.


O que você vai fazer?

Prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades de locação e venda de imóveis corporativos;

Atuar com proprietários, investidores e ocupantes;

Realizar visitas, negociações e acompanhamento de transações;

Manter-se atualizado sobre o mercado e tendências do setor.

Requisitos:

Experiência prévia com imóveis corporativos (ESCRITÓRIOS);

Perfil comercial e proativo, com habilidade de negociação;

Conhecimento do mercado imobiliário de São Paulo;

CRECI ativo.


QUEM SOMOS:

A Binswanger é uma organização internacional de consultoria imobiliária com mais de 80 anos de tradição. Criada nos Estados Unidos em 1931, a companhia assiste a clientes corporativos em mais de 100 países, nos cinco continentes.

Durante os anos 1990, a consultoria iniciou um programa de expansão internacional, formando alianças estratégicas com organizações imobiliárias em todo o mundo, período em que se estabeleceu também no Brasil, maior mercado imobiliário da América Latina.

Fundada em 1997, a Binswanger Brazil nasceu como escritório regional da rede, e em pouco mais de duas décadas se consolidou como uma das principais fornecedoras de serviços imobiliários para o mercado corporativo brasileiro.

Com sede em São Paulo, a companhia conta atualmente com uma das melhores estruturas imobiliárias em operação no país e oferece assistência de alcance global para todo o território nacional em um balcão único para clientes em diversos setores da economia.

Mais do que atender às necessidades de clientes, a Binswanger Brazil oferece linha completa de soluções imobiliárias e projetos personalizados para atender a todas as etapas dos processos imobiliários de seus parceiros de negócio.

Em 2023 realizamos o que foi um marco significativo para o setor imobiliário, anunciamos a fusão entre a Binswanger Brazil e a SDS Properties. Nossa decisão, motivada pela oportunidade de combinarmos tecnologia, dados, relacionamentos e expertise de equipes altamente referenciadas, buscou potencializar ferramentas, inteligência de mercado, capacidade de inovação e consequentemente apresentar aos nossos clientes o mais alto nível de atendimento em Real Estate do país.


O QUE FAZEMOS:

Transações & Assessoria Imobiliária;

Consultoria & Avaliações de Imóveis;

Geo Soluções e Regularização Documental;

Gerenciamento de Projetos e Obras e;

Property e Asset Management.

title: Product Manager
description:
Product Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly driven Product Manager to lead the end-to-end development of Pointsville’s digital products. You’ll turn ideas into impactful solutions by connecting business goals, user needs, and technical execution. This role focuses on defining vision, setting priorities, and delivering products that drive growth, innovation, and long-term value across emerging technologies and financial ecosystems.


What You’ll Do

Product Strategy and Planning

  • Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company goals.
  • Conduct market and competitor research to identify new product opportunities and emerging trends.
  • Gather and analyze requirements from users, partners, and internal stakeholders to inform product design and prioritization.
  • Translate business and technical needs into clear product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage and continuously refine the product backlog, balancing priorities and timelines across multiple initiatives.


Execution and Delivery

  • Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create user-centric designs and intuitive experiences.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution of product features and releases.
  • Lead product launches, define success metrics, and coordinate enablement with marketing, sales, and support teams.


Performance and Improvement

  • Monitor product performance post-launch, analyze user feedback, and drive continuous improvement and iteration.
  • Work closely with compliance and legal teams to ensure all product features adhere to regulatory requirements in the crypto and financial services space.
  • Facilitate cross-functional alignment, ensuring all teams are informed, empowered, and accountable.
  • Support documentation, go-to-market readiness, and internal communication for each product phase.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Business, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in fintech or financial services, with direct crypto experience.
  • Demonstrated success of launching and scaling successful web and/or enterprise products from concept to launch.
  • Experience with varying development methodologies and leading cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain, fintech, or emerging financial technologies preferred.
  • Skilled in data-driven decision making using metrics and analytics tools.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to bridge business and technical conversations.
  • High user empathy, strong prioritization abilities, and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Principal Consultant – SOC Transformation and XSIAM Deployment
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.
Job Description
Your Career
As a Principal Consultant for SOC Transformation & XSIAM Deployment, you will be a seasoned leader at the forefront of our most strategic customer engagements. You will leverage a rare blend of consultative presence, deep technical mastery, and executive influence to guide our customers through complex SOC transformations. Your primary role is to drive these large-scale programs, ensuring the successful execution of foundational elements like seamless log migration and the development of sophisticated detection strategies, to deliver measurable security outcomes in highly dynamic enterprise environments.
Your Impact
  • Serve as the lead strategic advisor and subject matter expert for customers undertaking a full-scale SOC modernization with XSIAM
  • Lead multi-national SOC transformation programs, consolidating fragmented detection and response processes into a unified, AI-driven platform
  • Direct enterprise-scale XSIAM deployments, guiding customers from initial strategy to full operationalization
  • Devise and oversee comprehensive log ingestion strategies to ensure high-quality data fuels the XSIAM platform
  • Architect and implement sophisticated detection strategies and correlation rules to fortify customer defenses against advanced threats
  • Fine-tune and optimize log sources and correlation rules to maximize system performance and detection efficacy
  • Identify opportunities to enhance analyst alert handling and response through automation
  • Transform ambiguity into structured action plans, driving accountability at every level of a customer engagement
  • Build and mentor high-performing professional services teams that blend consulting, engineering, and change management expertise
  • Partner with Product and R&D teams to incorporate field insights into roadmap priorities
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • A proven track record in modernizing Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to achieve automation, AI-driven detection, and measurable improvements in MTTD/MTTR
  • Exceptional executive presence, with strong verbal and written communication skills to engage with stakeholders from the SOC analyst to the CISO
  • Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior security leaders, with the ability to diagnose challenges and deliver strategic recommendations
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in deploying and integrating SIEM/security analytics solutions within large enterprise environments
  • 8+ years of experience with Security Operations Center (SOC) tooling, processes, and workflows
  • Hands-on technical mastery across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, cloud security, and threat intelligence
  • Ability to conceive, architect, and develop effective correlation and detection rules
  • Familiarity with a range of SIEM technologies, such as Splunk and IBM QRadar, is a plus
  • Strong expertise in Regular Expressions (Regex)
  • Relevant bachelor's degree or industry-recognized qualifications (CISSP, GIAC, etc.), is a plus.
  • PreSales is a Plus
  • 30% Travel
Additional Information
Our Professional Services team is critical to our success and mission. As part of this team, you enable customer success by providing support to clients post-sale. Our dedication to our customers doesn’t stop once they sign — it evolves. As threats and technology evolve, we stay in step to accomplish our mission. You’ll be involved in implementing new products, transitioning from old products to new, and fixing integrations and critical issues as they are raised. But you won’t wait for them to be raised, you’ll seek them out, too. We fix and identify technical problems with a pointed focus of providing the best customer support in the industry.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
description:
We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Test at XILO , a fast-growing AI-driven startup transforming the insurance industry. With 200+ clients, growing data, and fresh Series A funding, we’re scaling quickly — and we’re looking for someone to help us ensure quality and reliability at every step.


The Role:

You’ll lead the charge in shaping and scaling our test automation strategy , with a focus on end-to-end testing using Playwright and TypeScript. You’ll work closely with engineering teams to define best practices, build test coverage for new and existing features, and make testing a first-class citizen in our development lifecycle.


This is not a passive testing role — you’ll be embedded in sprint planning and start writing tests before the features are even built , anticipating behavior, aligning with developers, and enabling test-first workflows. While your main focus will be automation, you’ll also support high-priority manual validation when needed.


You’ll take ownership of:

  • Designing, maintaining, and improving our Playwright-based E2E test suites
  • Writing test coverage for cross-service platform workflows and domain-specific modules
  • Defining testing standards, tooling, and patterns used across all teams
  • Partnering with developers during sprint planning to prepare test coverage in advance
  • Leading CI/CD test integration and improving overall test stability and performance
  • Supporting critical release testing and mentoring engineers on writing integration/unit tests


What You’ll Bring:

  • ✔️ 5+ years of experience in software testing , with a strong focus on automation
  • ✔️ Deep knowledge of Playwright and TypeScript , and a track record of building resilient test systems
  • ✔️ Experience writing system-level and module-level E2E tests in a modern web platform
  • ✔️ Comfort working closely with developers and PMs to build test-first workflows
  • ✔️ Experience designing test strategies , introducing tools, and improving CI pipelines
  • ✔️ Bonus: Familiarity with Jest , Postman , Sonar , or performance/load testing tools


Why Join XILO?

  • ✅ A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • ✅ Endless career growth – Help define testing culture across teams and services
  • ✅ Strong leadership & backing – Work with experienced founders and top-tier investors
  • ✅ Full ownership – From strategy to tooling, you’ll shape how we ship confidently


If you’re looking for a high-impact QA/automation role where your work enables engineering velocity, product confidence, and great user experiences, let’s chat!

title: Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional no segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados robustos e escaláveis, com foco em integração, transformação e governança de dados na plataforma Snowflake.

Projetar e implementar soluções de ingestão e orquestração utilizando Azure Data Factory, Databricks e outras ferramentas do ecossistema Azure.

Integrar dados de diferentes fontes (REST, SOAP, OData APIs), garantindo a qualidade, consistência e performance dos processos.

Modelar dados corporativos com boas práticas de modelagem relacional (E/R, normalização, chaves primárias e estrangeiras).

Atuar em conjunto com arquitetos e engenheiros de dados para desenhar soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alta disponibilidade.

Administrar e versionar código por meio do GitHub e CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), aplicando automação e boas práticas de deploy.

Gerenciar componentes da infraestrutura Azure, como Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, Logic Apps e Azure Functions.

Monitorar performance, custos e qualidade dos pipelines, aplicando tunning e melhorias contínuas nos processos.

Colaborar com times globais em ambiente ágil, garantindo alinhamento entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.


O que você precisa ter

  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Data Engineer, com atuação prática em desenvolvimento de pipelines e soluções de dados em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Azure Data Factory, Snowflake e Databricks, com experiência em integração, transformação e governança de dados.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL, incluindo transformação, otimização e performance tuning.
  • Experiência em modelagem de dados e manipulação de dados semiestruturados (JSON, XML, Parquet).
  • Vivência com CI/CD, GitHub Actions e práticas de versionamento de código.
  • Sólida compreensão da infraestrutura Azure (Blob Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, monitoramento, Azure Functions).
  • Experiência com orquestração e agendamento de jobs (ADF triggers, Logic Apps, FiveTran).
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação em ambiente internacional.


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência com estratégias de governança e segurança de dados (GDPR, criptografia, controle de acesso).
  • Vivência com monitoramento de qualidade de dados e frameworks de controle.
  • Conhecimento em otimização de custos e performance em ambientes cloud.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e atuação em times multifuncionais.
  • Capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e habilidade para propor soluções sustentáveis e eficientes.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: ServiceNOW AI trainner (Remote | PJ)
description:
Position Details

  • Position: Contractor / PJ (no medical/paid leave)
  • 100% remote
  • Project Time: 2 months
  • Engagement: Full-time (40 hours/week)
  • Time Zone Overlap: Minimum 3 hours with CST (18-21h Brasilia Time)



We are seeking experienced professionals with deep functional expertise in ServiceNow products , including Customer Service Management (CSM), IT Service Management (ITSM) , or HR Service Delivery (HRSD) , to contribute to AI model training initiatives.

This role focuses on translating real business workflows and decision logic into structured, data-driven tasks that strengthen AI reasoning and understanding of enterprise processes. It is not a platform configuration or app development role .


Role Overview

The ideal candidate will combine ServiceNow domain expertise , analytical capability , and prompt-engineering skills to design realistic, scenario-based tasks for AI learning.

  • Define decision frameworks for Reinforcement Learning initiatives, including taxonomy design, realistic scenario creation, and evaluation criteria.
  • Develop scenario-driven tasks that mirror real ServiceNow workflows (case handling, SLA tracking, HR requests, IT incident response).
  • Write clear, natural instructions aligned with ServiceNow business processes.
  • Represent tasks in JSON format with clarity and consistency.
  • Use SQL to analyze and validate data accuracy.
  • Apply prompt engineering to structure effective task instructions.
  • Collaborate with peers to expand scenarios across ServiceNow domains (CSM, ITSM, HRSD).
  • Document patterns, examples, and best practices for scalable use.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 4–6 years of experience in ServiceNow, particularly CSM, ITSM, or HRSD modules.
  • Strong knowledge of workflows, cases, incidents, SLAs, and knowledge management.
  • Proficiency in JSON and structured data handling .
  • Solid understanding of SQL for data validation.
  • Experience in AI model training workflows or structured data creation.
  • Strong prompt engineering , analytical, and logical structuring skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills (customer-facing experience is a plus).


Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS–ITSM / CSM / HRSD)
  • Exposure to AI/ML workflows and Agile methodologies
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering best practices

• Manter-se atualizado sobre as mais recentes ferramentas, tecnologias e abordagens na área de SRE.

• Inspirar e liderar a equipe a pensar de forma inovadora, desenvolvendo soluções que mantenham a Dentsu à frente do mercado.

• Contribuir para a comunidade de SRE, compartilhando conhecimento e melhores práticas.
